description: A category of the business rules catalog. vcita manages the catalog. Each category belongs to one topic and has a default load mode. The pair of topic and code is unique.

uid.description: The unique identifier (UID) of the category (e.g., "a357419e-93f4-4ce2-abc4-0e0c12e945c5").

topic.description:
The topic of the category (e.g., "reply_to_clients", "knowledge_and_files").

* `reply_to_clients` - Rules for replies to clients.
* `ai_receptionist` - Rules for the AI Receptionist.
* `bizai_chat` - Rules for BizAI Chat.
* `notes` - Rules for note summaries and call transcripts.
* `preferences` - Preferences and priorities that every agent reads.
* `knowledge_and_files` - Knowledge items, FAQ and documents.

code.description: The category code, unique within the topic (e.g., "tone_of_voice", "faq"). Rules carry it as `category_code`.

default_load_mode.description:
How agents load the rules of the category when a rule has no own load mode (e.g., "always", "search").

* `always` - Agents load the rules with the list.
* `search` - Agents find the rules through search only.

label_key.description: The translation key of the category name (e.g., "bizai.rules_knowledge.groups.knowledge_and_files.faq.name").

description.description: The translation key of the category description (e.g., "bizai.rules_knowledge.groups.knowledge_and_files.faq.description" or null).

sort_order.description: The display order of the category across the catalog (e.g., 10, 140). Lower values come first.

is_active.description: Whether the category is open for rules (e.g., true, false). Writes accept only the codes of active categories.

created_at.description: When the category was created, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2026-11-09T00:00:00.000Z").

updated_at.description: When the category was last updated, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2026-11-09T00:00:00.000Z").
